structured.answer: I think that at my age I can take the money out tax-free after 3 years (the page says 6 years, but 3 for people who have reached retirement age). The page's example, with a 12,000 salary over 5 years, gives about 66,500 ₪ in hand, but I didn't enter my own salary, so I'll check with my son and the employer before I rely on it.

stuck.why: The red minus 13,974 under 'המס' came before the amount in hand and frightened me. It took time to understand it's tax for taking money out before 6 years.
The calculator is set to 5 years and counts tax. Screen 1 says that at retirement age 3 years is enough, and I couldn't tell whether the calculator knows that.
I don't know my salary at the new job, and I didn't understand 'תשואה בשנה 7', so I left the numbers as they were.

findings.what: The red minus (−13,974 tax) and the hatched red stand out before the amount in hand. It's frightening and makes you want to back away.
The calculator shows 5 years with tax and ignores the 3-year rule for people at retirement age that is written on the first screen.
English letters and investment words (S&P 500, מדד, אג"ח צמודה) right next to the calculator make it feel like the page isn't for me.
The explanations under the chart are small, grey and hard to read even enlarged.
The dark background with white and grey letters tires the eyes.
Many numbers in one paragraph (50,719, 29,768, 15,794): busy and confusing.
Codes like KH-19 and PF-18 and the 'חוקים וכללים · N' tags mean nothing to me and add clutter.
The yield of 7% is only an assumption ('לא תחזית'), and that is written in small letters at the bottom.
